cases.name: delegate replacement failure reaches enclosing catch

steps.source: let outcome="pending";async function scenario(){let trace="";const d:any={next(){return {done:false,value:uint8(1)};},return(){trace+="r";return {done:true,value:{}};},[Symbol.asyncIterator](){return this;}};async function* g():AsyncGenerator.<uint8,string,void>{try{yield* d;return "body";}catch(e){trace+=e.name;return "caught";}finally{trace+="f";}}const it:any=g();await it.next();return trace+":"+(await it.return()).value+":"+trace;}scenario().then(v=>{outcome=v;},e=>{outcome="UNCAUGHT:"+e.name+":"+e.message;});"scheduled";

cases.name: delegate getters retain order

steps.source: let outcome="pending";async function scenario(){let trace="";const d:any={next(){return {done:false,value:uint8(1)};},get return(){trace+="r";return function(){trace+="c";return {get done(){trace+="d";return true;},get value(){trace+="v";return undefined;}};};},[Symbol.asyncIterator](){return this;}};async function* g():AsyncGenerator.<uint8,string,void>{yield* d;return "body";}const it:any=g();await it.next();const x=await it.return();return trace+":"+x.value;}scenario().then(v=>{outcome=v;},e=>{outcome="UNCAUGHT:"+e.name+":"+e.message;});"scheduled";

cases.name: delegate done true value is not additionally awaited

steps.source: let outcome="pending";async function scenario(){let reads=0;const value:any={get then(){reads++;return function(resolve){resolve("hidden");};}};const d:any={next(){return {done:false,value:uint8(1)};},return(){return {done:true,value};},[Symbol.asyncIterator](){return this;}};async function* g():AsyncGenerator.<uint8,object,void>{yield* d;return {};}const it:any=g();await it.next();const x=await it.return();return (x.value===value)+":"+reads;}scenario().then(v=>{outcome=v;},e=>{outcome="UNCAUGHT:"+e.name+":"+e.message;});"scheduled";

cases.name: delegate Promise value does not satisfy string terminal

steps.source: let outcome="pending";async function scenario(){const d:any={next(){return {done:false,value:uint8(1)};},return(){return {done:true,value:Promise.resolve("hidden")};},[Symbol.asyncIterator](){return this;}};async function* g():AsyncGenerator.<uint8,string,void>{yield* d;return "body";}const it:any=g();await it.next();let failure="";try{await it.return();}catch(e){failure=e.name;}return failure;}scenario().then(v=>{outcome=v;},e=>{outcome="UNCAUGHT:"+e.name+":"+e.message;});"scheduled";

cases.name: delegate done false continues to fresh body return

steps.source: let outcome="pending";async function scenario(){let count=0;const bad:any=undefined;const d:any={next(){count++;return {done:count>1,value:count>1?bad:uint8(1)};},return(){return {done:false,value:uint8(2)};},[Symbol.asyncIterator](){return this;}};async function* g():AsyncGenerator.<uint8,string,void>{return yield* d;}const it:any=g();await it.next();const x=await it.return();let failure="";try{await it.next();}catch(e){failure=e.name;}return x.done+":"+x.value+":"+failure;}scenario().then(v=>{outcome=v;},e=>{outcome="UNCAUGHT:"+e.name+":"+e.message;});"scheduled";

cases.name: delegate call rejection remains original error

steps.source: let outcome="pending";async function scenario(){const d:any={next(){return {done:false,value:uint8(1)};},return(){return Promise.reject(new RangeError("delegate"));},[Symbol.asyncIterator](){return this;}};async function* g():AsyncGenerator.<uint8,string,void>{yield* d;return "body";}const it:any=g();await it.next();let failure="";try{await it.return();}catch(e){failure=e.name+":"+e.message;}return failure;}scenario().then(v=>{outcome=v;},e=>{outcome="UNCAUGHT:"+e.name+":"+e.message;});"scheduled";

cases.name: awaited close cannot revive invalidated element borrow

steps.source: let outcome="pending";async function scenario(){let a:[].<uint8>=[1,2];a.reserve(10);let read="";async function* g():AsyncGenerator.<uint8,string,void>{let ref r=a[1];try{yield uint8(1);return "body";}finally{try{read=String(r);}catch(e){read=e.name;}}}const it:any=g();await it.next();const value:any={then(resolve){a.pop();resolve("closed");}};const x=await it.return(value);return read+":"+x.value;}scenario().then(v=>{outcome=v;},e=>{outcome="UNCAUGHT:"+e.name+":"+e.message;});"scheduled";
